title: PT Round-02, 2025 Registration Form
bodyHtml:
IPC is going to conduct PT round 02/2025 in Microbiological Assay of Antibiotics in Biological Discipline (Drugs & Pharmaceuticals).

You are requested to find the attached Registration form and send your consent with filled registration form by e-mail at qualityassurance-ipc@gov.in on or before 05th August 2025.
Please click to download Registration Form.PDF (opens in a new tab)
